success_patterns: Agents treated short declarative prompts as clues and returned the requested entity or category rather than an associated detail.
Agents used context passages to identify direct answers, including when the clue referred to something “seen here.”

patch.reasoning: The answer-type and requested-slot behavior is already covered by the skill. Context-grounding and visual-reference rules have also been proposed and rejected in earlier steps, so these trajectories do not justify another edit.
